# Smart Search 0.3.3

Smart Search 0.3.3 fixes prompt-driven Firecrawl JSON extraction and prevents incomplete requests from consuming credits.

## Fixes

- Adds `--prompt` to `fetch extract` for schema-less structured extraction.
- Requires at least one of `--prompt` or `--schema` before contacting Firecrawl; both options may be combined.
- Reclassifies the old URL-only mode as a local `parameter_error` instead of sending `formats: [{"type":"json"}]` and later reporting a misleading `parse_error`.
- Improves unexpected missing-`data.json` diagnostics with Firecrawl response status, returned data keys, and truncated `raw_evidence`.
- Documents the current Firecrawl v2 JSON mode contract in the English and Chinese README files and bundled Agent skill.

## Verification

- Python test suite: 205 tests.
- npm wrapper, packaged npx skill installation, and npm tarball validation.
- Live prompt-only extraction returned Python `3.14.6` from `python.org`.
- Live schema-plus-prompt extraction returned `{"latest_python_3_release":"3.14.6"}`.
- Missing prompt/schema was rejected locally without a provider request.

Provider behavior was checked on 2026-07-26 against the official [Firecrawl JSON mode documentation](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/llm-extract), [data extractor comparison](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/developer-guides/usage-guides/choosing-the-data-extractor), and [Scrape API reference](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/api-reference/endpoint/scrape).

## Install or update

```bash
npm install -g @shirlytaylor73/smart-search@latest
smart-search --version
```
